known_differences_from_fetch_script: Rape is unmapped: Crime_Type has 18 values (evidence/raw_cache_profile.json; evidence/doc_00.json types) and none is a rape or sex-offense category, so the feed cannot supply rape counts (official 54-93 per year in evidence/official_totals.csv).

Crime_Type 'Homicide' is mapped to murder but the publisher gives no definition; it may include negligent manslaughter (09B) or justifiable homicide (09C), which the source cannot separate. Pull counts by year of Date: 5, 4, 12, 8, 9, 3 for 2018-2023 vs official murder 3, 5, 13, 0, 9, 10.

No incident number is published; OBJECTID (unique on all 43,218 rows) is the only id, so de-duplication is a no-op and multi-row incidents cannot be collapsed. Among the 30,038 rows in mapped categories, 255 rows fall in 121 groups sharing Date, Address and Crime_Type (up to 6 'Vehicle Theft' rows at one time and block); across all rows 66 Date+Address groups (145 rows) carry more than one Crime_Type. Rows may therefore represent offenses or vehicles rather than incidents in some cases.

Crime_Type is a publisher summary category, not a NIBRS/UCR code; 'Larceny' and 'Larceny from Auto' are taken as 23A-23H, 'Vehicle Theft' as 240, 'Burglary-Residential'/'Burglary-NonResidential' as 220, 'Assault-Aggravated' as 13A, without published crosswalks. 'Assault-Simple', 'Fraud', 'Vandalism' and other categories are left out.

Coverage: the layer's Date runs 2018-01-01T00:00Z to 2023-06-30T11:11Z (query of raw_cache); 2023 is a half year and 2024-2025 have no rows. The 2021 official totals are all 0 (evidence/official_totals.csv), so 2021 cannot reconcile.
2,334 of 43,218 rows (43,218 - 40,884 non-null __arcgis_latitude, evidence/raw_cache_profile.json) have no geometry and are dropped; 1,314 of them are in mapped categories.
notes: Date is the only date field (esriFieldTypeDate, alias 'Date', evidence/doc_00.json fields); the publisher does not say whether it is occurrence or report date, and it is used as published. It is stored as epoch ms with dateFieldsTimeReference timeZone UTC (evidence/doc_00.json); years are taken from the UTC timestamp, and the where clause matches the survey's probe_where and the archive's filter (packet.json case_text). Coordinates are the feature geometry (__arcgis_latitude/__arcgis_longitude; source spatial reference WKID 102100, evidence/doc_00.json). The publisher states no rounding or offset, but Address is generalized to the hundred block (e.g. '2400 BLOCK WHIPPLE RD', evidence/raw_cache_profile.json) and points repeat heavily (13,188 distinct points at 6-decimal rounding vs 40,884 located rows; '0 BLOCK SOUTHLAND MALL' has 464 rows at 1 point), so points are likely block- or site-level geocodes rather than exact locations. Each row carries one Crime_Type; with one rule per category no row can match two offenses. count_unit 'incident' follows the survey (evidence/registry_row.json count_unit) with the caveat on multi-row groups above. Agency is 'Hayward PD, CA' on every row, matching the single scope candidate 06:municipal:place:0633000 Hayward city (evidence/scope_candidates.csv) and ORI CA0010600. The layer description and copyright text are empty, so no redactions or exclusions are stated. Pull counts by year of Date (2018/2019/2020/2022) vs official: aggravated assault 185/186/162/193 vs 217/218/205/257; robbery 338/262/237/241 vs 364/275/253/241; burglary (Residential + NonResidential) 613/502/663/573 vs 545/448/622/502; larceny (Larceny + Larceny from Auto) 2832/3165/2891/2600 vs 2849/3197/2850/2447; motor vehicle theft 1393/1275/1918/1740 vs 1376/1241/1878/1613 (GROUP BY year, Crime_Type on raw_cache, before the coordinate drop).
